raw.details:
About HierroCTF 2026

Are you ready to put your cybersecurity skills to the test?

HierroCTF 2026 is an exciting Capture The Flag (CTF) competition designed to challenge participants' technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities through cybersecurity-oriented challenges.

Organized by HierroShield Pvt. Ltd., in collaboration with MIT College of Management and Computer Applications, MIT-ADT University, this competition provides an opportunity for aspiring cybersecurity professionals, ethical hackers, and technology enthusiasts to showcase their skills.

What to Expect:

Participants will get an opportunity to:

  • Test their cybersecurity and technical knowledge.
  • Solve challenging security-oriented problems.
  • Apply logical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
  • Compete with other cybersecurity enthusiasts.
  • Showcase their abilities in a competitive environment.

Competition Details

  • Event: HierroCTF 2026
  • Date: Friday, 20 November 2026
  • Time: 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
  • Venue: MIT-ADT University, South Block, 8th Floor, Pune
  • Prize Pool: ₹10,000

Prize Pool

Total Prize Pool: ₹10,000

Compete, demonstrate your skills, and earn recognition for your cybersecurity expertise.

Organizers

HierroShield Pvt. Ltd.

In collaboration with:

MIT College of Management and Computer Applications
MIT-ADT University, Pune

Join Our WhatsApp Community

Stay connected with fellow participants and receive important event announcements, updates, instructions, and other competition-related information.

Join the official HierroCTF 2026 WhatsApp Group:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/KobAULnW60e9v2Nm5P9LxY

Registration

Registrations are now open!

Take on the challenge, sharpen your skills, and be part of HierroCTF 2026.

Register now and get ready to capture the flag!
